method: Full generated one-tile parcel retained at its original metre scale; lossless translation into a transparent padded 64px frame. No silhouette fitting, resizing or nonuniform scaling.
camera: Orthographic 2:1 dimetric ground axes; painted local edge variation.
notes: The generated prompt places a full one-tile parcel in its original square source. Registration pads that parcel to the next power-of-two frame without resizing its artwork, permitting exact native density copies at Region/Town/Detail. Runtime 64px frame contains a 48px parcel and calibrated station door; the larger buffer adds transparency only. Gameplay still uses one tile.
